title: Literal occurrences in a clause
statement: Let a seedwise three-CNF reduction have a positive number $K$ of clauses, each nonempty and of width at most three, with its stated completeness and soundness properties. For any seed, clause index $q\in\{0,\ldots,K-1\}$, and literal $\ell$ over the $r+K$ variables, $\ell$ occurs in clause $q$ if and only if it is one of the three literals obtained by taking the clause’s literal at position $j$ modulo its width, for some $j\in\{0,1,2\}$.
hypotheses_covered: A seedwise three-CNF reduction with positive clause count $K$
